messages.text: If you'd like that same blue-ocean look but as a floor piece, the Statesman 20-inch Illuminated Blue Ocean Floor Globe with Walnut Stand is our top floor pick in that style — a large illuminated globe with a hand-applied map and a handsome walnut stand, a real centrepiece for a room. You'll find it under that exact name in search, ready to add to your cart. What room are you picturing it in?

That's a great fit — the Statesman's size and walnut stand give an office real presence, like something out of a well-appointed study. Is this for your own desk area, or more for a shared or client-facing space?

Good to know — the Statesman is a floor-standing piece, so it'd sit on the floor right beside your desk area rather than on the desktop itself, giving your office a real focal point.
